scope: Read-only receipt/report coherence review. No host, provider, database, browser, or credential operation was performed.
coherence_findings: The first activation's group failure and own rollback are recorded; R4's snapshot failure is pre-mutation; R5 is the successful activation and is the only activation claimed as installed.

Seller and Performance setup checks are distinguished from browser/customer-card mutation. The adapter reports Seller CONNECTED and Performance CONNECTED with NATIVE_OWNER_CONFIGURED_PAIR; namespace tests record wrong-secret, other-tenant, other-store, and wrong-kind rejection.

The first refresh-hook installation failed because systemd hid another unit's credential; the diagnostic records this. The R2 installation uses an explicit single-file read-only Ozon bind and passes both proof-current-generation and real Performance IPC checks.

Readback records current generation match, current code hashes, public homepage/login behavior, free disk and inode reserve, and protected service/pointer state. It correctly identifies alice-lab-worker as inactive and says this work did not restart the native core.

Both reports now state that owner browser/card transition, DB promotion, provider reports, financial data, and voice flow were not performed; AL-S05 remains open. Manual owner steps are presented as the next action, not as completed validation.
limits: This review verifies consistency of the supplied receipts and reports, not the live host independently.
Performance identity is qualified through the existing owner-configured native pair, not a provider-issued crosswalk for arbitrary credentials.
The card remains at its prior stored state until the owner performs the listed UI refresh/check action; no customer browser flow or database mutation is claimed.
